name: Forward Shadow Laboratory
purpose: Freeze research before outcomes, resolve only after the horizon, and create auditable forward evidence.
rules: Research is deep-copied and cryptographically hashed at capture.
Resolution verifies frozen research has not changed.
Outcome time must be after capture and requested horizon.
Stale or unavailable evidence produces VOID, not a prediction.
Resolved records remain paper/research evidence only.
Forward results do not automatically grant agent authority.
